restInst.description: An instance of the REST type.

sourceControlRepoName.description: The name of the repository set up in the respective source control host (e.g. `c3server`).

token.description: The personal access token used to access repo and construct the {@link SourceControlRestApi} instance

title:
Base type to interact with a source control system repository through REST.

Note: When trying to debug the JavaScript implementations of types that extend this type, it's useful to directly
call the REST API to look at the response object, or to read about the response object in the API's official
documentation. Otherwise, it might be hard to understand parts of the implementation that access properties
of a REST response object.
name: SourceControlRestApi
